Chapter 1130: 2 Possession Of The Ancestor Of Fierce Sun (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1130: Chapter 2 Possession of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun (Request Subscription)

“The merits have been awarded?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up.

In the war between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, the Red Pine King was the commander. Qingfen Domain won, and logically, the greatest credit should go to Red Pine King.

Yet, Red Pine King transferred all the war merits to Lin Yuan.

The merits obtained by the war commander can be directly exchanged in the Ancient Country’s treasury for resource inheritance, which is extremely precious.

This is also the greatest confidence for the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and its fervent kings to win the war.

Why do the high and mighty Heavenly Venerates obey the ancient royal family? Isn’t it precisely because of the numerous resources and inheritances within the Ancient Country’s treasury?

“Your merit is a hundred twenty thousand, Galaxy brother.”

King Chibao said, “A hundred twenty thousand merits, not a small amount. A normal Heavenly Venerate-level secret treasure weapon costs about seventy-eight thousand merits.”

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

In the war between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, Lin Yuan reaped numerous rewards, with merits being only a part of them.

Additionally, there are spoils obtained from various Great Lords on the battlefield, and the ‘ransom’ from the Da Ling Ancient Country soon after, etc.

“The hundred twenty thousand merits have been distributed. If Galaxy brother wants to redeem them, you can go directly to this place.” King Chibao gave Lin Yuan a location, the entrance to the national treasury.

Anyone who has merits with Fierce Sun Ancient Country can enter to redeem rewards.

“Good.”

Lin Yuan inwardly looked forward to it.

The treasury of Fierce Sun Ancient Country encompasses all sorts of resource inheritances, and most importantly, most resources will never appear in the outside world.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was about to continue chatting with King Chibao.

Suddenly, his expression changed as he looked toward the outside of the mansion.

“What’s wrong?” King Chibao asked.

“Someone is visiting me,” Lin Yuan said.

Having just arrived in the capital, without relatives or acquaintances, someone visiting so soon?

“Hahaha, I almost forgot.” King Chibao smiled: “This mansion has been watched by many, Galaxy brother, even if Your Majesty doesn’t announce externally, it couldn’t stay hidden.”

“I see.” Lin Yuan nodded.

Moreover, the Nine-Pattern Warship that greeted Lin Yuan was quite conspicuous and would definitely receive much attention.

“Should Galaxy brother go out and take a look?”

King Chibao smiled and said, “Those who immediately come to pay respects to Galaxy brother generally have good intentions.”

“Then let’s meet them.”

Lin Yuan nodded and immediately walked out of the mansion with King Chibao.

“Galaxy brother.”

“Galaxy brother.”

One figure after another quickly walked up.

“Just now, I was curious who warranted His Majesty sending the Nine-Pattern Warship for greeting, didn’t expect it to be Galaxy brother.”

“No wonder, no wonder.”

Those who came to pay respects to Lin Yuan were mostly from the royal family, and at this moment, all these royals looked at Lin Yuan with great enthusiasm.

Lin Yuan responded to each of the royal members one by one.

Long before arriving in the capital, King Chibao had explained the situation in the capital to him.

The capital of Fierce Sun Ancient Country mainly has two factions.

One is the royal family faction, the other is the Heavenly Venerate faction.

Within the royal family, there are seventeen major branches, each branch has an ultimate core royal member stationed.

Outside the seventeen major branches, there are some royal families, but they cannot form a scale and can only depend on the seventeen major branch royals.

Theoretically, based on Lin Yuan’s strength, he could completely establish the eighteenth royal branch.

“The ones coming to visit me are mostly royals, as for those Heavenly Venerate followers, not a single one?” Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

Is it that the Heavenly Venerates don’t know he took over this mansion? Obviously not possible.

“It seems those Heavenly Venerate kings do not have goodwill towards my presence.” Lin Yuan understood the reason.

The important resources of Fierce Sun Ancient Country are undoubtedly tilted towards core royals, each additional core royal equates to a portion of resources being distributed away, naturally causing displeasure among the Heavenly Venerates.

Especially since Lin Yuan’s exhibited strength exceeds that of a normal ultimate core royal member, walking far on the path of breaking the Heavenly Venerate’s shackles.

This makes the Heavenly Venerates even more wary.

However, Lin Yuan is not worried. Within Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the royal family is the absolute ruler, and the Heavenly Venerates even if wary dare not take any actions.

…

After handling the royal family members who came to visit, Lin Yuan parted with King Chibao and headed to the entrance of the national treasury.

Carrying a hefty amount of a hundred twenty thousand merits, Lin Yuan was eager to see the inherited treasures within the national treasury.

This is also Lin Yuan’s main purpose in coming to the capital, to accelerate cultivation with the help of these resources.

The capital of Fierce Sun is vast like a Spatial-Temporal Maze. Lin Yuan, guided by the map given by King Chibao, finally arrived before a great hall.

Lin Yuan looked at this great hall in front of him, with no one guarding outside, only two statue guardians standing.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the two statue guardians and faintly felt an inexplicable aura fluctuation from them.

“These statue guardians possess at least Heavenly Venerate level combat power.”

Lin Yuan’s brow faintly twitched, sensing a threat.

Given Lin Yuan’s current strength, only a Heavenly Venerate level expert could pose a threat to him.

“Bloodline and merit verified, permission to enter granted.” As Lin Yuan observed the statues guarding the entrance, a voice faintly echoed in his ears.

“Can I go in now?” Lin Yuan immediately proceeded forward.

The entrance to the grand hall opened, and Lin Yuan stepped inside.

Upon entering the hall, Lin Yuan found himself in an independent space.

Nearby, flames gathered to form a phantom elder who smiled and said, “Descendant of Fierce Sun, please select the treasure inheritance you wish to exchange.”

“Please take a look.”

The phantom elder waved his hand, infinite flames intertwined, forming an array of treasure resource information.

“These treasure resource inheritances are ranked from high to low based on the merit required.” The phantom elder said with a smile.

Lin Yuan nodded, immediately starting to examine from the highest point.

First in line was not a resource treasure inheritance but an opportunity.

It required one trillion merits to exchange—

An opportunity to become one with the Ancestor.

Being one with the Ancestor, perceiving the profound mysteries of the Ancestor level.

…

Lin Yuan’s eyes widened instantly.

Become one with the Ancestor?

Become one with the Ancestor of Fierce Sun?

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun is a thirteenth-level temporal lifeform; to merge with such a being, viewing timelines from a thirteenth-level perspective is something Lin Yuan wouldn’t even dare imagine.

What kind of existence is a thirteenth-level temporal lifeform? How would they allow ants to merge with them?

For training disciples, a thirteenth-level temporal lifeform wouldn’t need to train any disciples at all. If they were truly interested, they would create legacies like the creator of the Chaos Void’s “Infinite Void” legacy and toss them out; whoever obtains them can train.

As for merging?

Not to mention thirteenth-level temporal lifeforms, even Lin Yuan wouldn’t allow other lifeforms to merge with him, after all, in a merged state, they can perceive Lin Yuan’s physical body and soul, and many secrets are hard to hide.

“The Ancestor of Fierce Sun truly…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, realizing that the Ancestor of Fierce Sun was indeed troubled to nurture his descendants, even offering a chance to merge.

“Although unsure how to increase the chance to survive time cycles, merging with a temporal lifeform and perceiving the past and future timelines would undoubtedly enhance understanding of the essence of time.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The drop of temporal bloodline left by the Moyu Tower Master allowed Lin Yuan to understand much; how much more if he were to merge with a living thirteenth-level temporal lifeform?

“But one trillion merits?”

Lin Yuan’s mouth slightly twitched; he previously thought carrying 120,000 merits was a huge fortune, but now compared to one trillion merits, it’s almost negligible.

It’s important to know that the war between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain was almost single-handedly turned by Lin Yuan. Besides, he killed King Lingshen, the extreme core royal.

Under such circumstances, Lin Yuan obtained 120,000 merits.

Normally winning such a level of war, which means repelling the invasion of the enemy domain, the commander’s merit would be around twenty to thirty thousand.

Or even less.

That’s why King Chibao said Lin Yuan’s 120,000 merits were already a lot.

Over half of Lin Yuan’s 120,000 merits came from killing King Lingshen, the extreme core royal.

“No matter what, the opportunity to become one with the Ancestor of Fierce Sun must be grasped.” Lin Yuan made up his mind.

Although one trillion merits are extremely distant for Lin Yuan now, at least there’s hope.

This opportunity is countless times better than those great saints in the Chaos Void.

Those unparalleled great saints in the Chaos Void paid unknown prices to pursue traces of thirteenth-level temporal lifeforms, while Lin Yuan could directly merge with thirteenth-level temporal lifeforms?

What a rare chance is this?

…

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and continued to look down.

The following resources of treasure inheritance, opportunities to enter mysterious places, are equally precious, making Lin Yuan envious.

For instance, the opportunity to train in this world’s Primordial Lands? Lin Yuan once entered the Immortal Realm’s Primordial Lands, where the rules of a world manifest truly, perceiving rules were as simple as eating and drinking.

The training opportunity in this world’s Primordial Lands? How many true rules must be manifested?

Although this training opportunity does not require one trillion merits, it requires ninety billion merits, which is still somewhat out of reach for Lin Yuan.

Additionally, there are some secret treasure weapons, with incredible power.

Lin Yuan calmed himself and continued to look down.

“For me, there’s no need to exchange for secret treasure weapons.” Lin Yuan thought to himself; he preferred to exchange for inheritance guides.

Because comprehending the inheritance guides can equally be applied to the true form’s Primordial Spirit incarnation in the Chaos Void, offering higher value for cost. As for secret treasure weapons? Bringing them to the Chaos Void requires paying the price of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Although Lin Yuan currently has plenty of World-Breaking Origin Force, having absorbed and accumulated over a million World-Breaking Origin Forces during the cosmic cataclysm, there’s no need to use the precious World-Breaking Origin Force on this.

Besides, compared to external forces like secret treasure weapons, Lin Yuan prefers enhancing his own strength.

Using secret treasure weapons to boost strength comes with many limitations, and if lost, one would revert to their original state.

“Which one should I exchange?”

Lin Yuan directly set his target on inheritance guides worth under ten thousand merits; indeed, many inheritance guides valued at several million or tens of millions of merits were more enticing to Lin Yuan, but unfortunately, he didn’t have enough merits.

“You’ll be the one.”

After watching for half a day, Lin Yuan finally made up his mind.
